summary.text: Doug Fiefia is a Republican state representative from Utah, serving District 48 since January 2025, who is the Republican candidate for Utah State Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary over incumbent Dan McCay and faces Democrat A. Dane Anderson.

paragraphs.text: Doug Fiefia earned bachelor's degrees in marketing and business administration from Utah State University and an M.B.A. from Rice University.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes technology sales, and he owns SOJO Construction.
Fiefia was first seated in the Utah House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, and is not seeking re-election to that seat in 2026.
